alerts.title: EFV CNS Toxicity: Insomnia
alerts.message: Guidelines list persistent central nervous system toxicity, including insomnia and abnormal dreams, as a major adverse event for EFV. The patient has been on an EFV-based regimen since February 2024 and presents with poor sleep and vivid dreams for several weeks. This is a known side effect of EFV. No other medications or acute distress are noted that would suggest an alternative cause.

evidence.recommended_action: Consider substituting EFV for persistent CNS toxicity as per guideline management.

alerts.title: Missing TDF Renal Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines state that for experienced patients on TDF, serum creatinine and eGFR should be done every 12 months as a screening procedure. TDF is associated with chronic kidney disease and acute kidney injury. The patient is on TDF, but no renal function tests (RFTs) are documented in the provided history or clinician's plan for today's visit.

evidence.recommended_action: Perform serum creatinine and eGFR as part of routine annual monitoring for patients on TDF.
